chunks: Yunus ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from Muhammad ibn Mudarib, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever accuses his wife before consummating the marriage with her shall be flogged with the hadd, while she is still his wife.

key_terms.قَذَفَ: he accused falsely of illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: he consummates the marriage with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man accuses his wife before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband who falsely accuses his wife before consummation of marriage. It states that the hadd punishment for qadhf applies to him, affirming the protection of the wife's honor and the seriousness of false accusation.
